summary: Interacting with certain villagers with the villager trade rebalance enabled causes client crash
description: When interacting with a villager with the villager trade rebalance enabled, if that villager s career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items (e.g. plains armorer), then the game will crash. To reproduce: - Create a new world. Make sure the villager trade rebalance is enabled. - Level an armorer up to either expert (does not apply to expert level taiga villagers) or master level. - Save and quit the world. - Reopen the world. - Interact with the armorer. - The game will crash. I ve also attached both a crash report from a vanilla client and one that is deobfuscated with the official mappings.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world and ensure the villager trade rebalance is enabled.
3. Level an armorer villager up to either expert or master level.
4. Save and quit the world.
5. Reopen the world.
6. Interact with the armorer villager.
7. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: When interacting with certain villagers while the villager trade rebalance is enabled, the game crashes if the villager's career and level can produce trades that include enchanted items, such as those offered by a plains armorer. To reproduce this issue, a player should create a new world with the villager trade rebalance feature turned on, then level an armorer to either expert or master level, noting that this issue does not affect expert level taiga villagers. After saving and quitting the world, the player should reopen it and attempt to interact with the armorer. Upon doing so, the game will crash. Relevant crash reports have been attached, including one from a vanilla client and another that has been deobfuscated using the official mappings, which may assist developers in diagnosing the issue.
Expected Behavior: When interacting with a villager with the villager trade rebalance enabled, the game should allow the player to successfully trade without crashing, even if the villager's career and level could generate trades involving enchanted items. The interaction should proceed normally, allowing the player to purchase items or emeralds as intended, without any disruptions or errors occurring.
